description.value: TRU Library is the academic library of Thompson Rivers University, Kamloops—one of British Columbia's major post-secondary institutions. It sits on the main Kamloops campus and primarily serves students and faculty. Touring cyclists passing through the city may find the campus a convenient urban waypoint, though cyclist-specific services are unconfirmed.
